pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "under_siege" (banner UNDER SIEGE) is on the record: crisis under_siege is active (threat and hunger families both on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis under_siege: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Nothing moves through the gates. {settlement} lives on what is already inside the walls, and counts it daily.
The walls are held from outside; the fields beyond them have not been worked since the lines closed.
Trade stops at the gate rather than the market now. The siege decides what the town eats.
{settlement} is shut, and the shutting is not the town's decision; every arrangement inside the walls has been rebuilt around the gates staying closed.
{settlement}'s stores are being counted daily and issued against a list, and the list is shorter than the town.
Nobody goes in or out of {settlement}, and the walls have people on them at hours walls do not normally have people on them.
lines.note: "nobody goes in or out" denies arrivals

lines.text: Nothing moves on the roads. {settlement} lives on what is already inside the town, and counts it daily.
The town is held from outside; the fields beyond it have not been worked since the lines closed.
{settlement} is shut, and the shutting is not the town's decision; every arrangement inside the town has been rebuilt around the roads staying closed.
Nobody goes in or out of {settlement}, and the edges of the town are kept at hours nobody normally keeps them.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "famine" (banner FAMINE) is on the record: crisis famine is active (hunger family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis famine: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: There is not enough to eat, and the shortfall is public now rather than private. The granary answers fewer hands each week.
Hunger has moved from the poorest streets into the ordinary ones; what the fields returned does not reach the table.
The market has grain, and the price of it has become a kind of politics; families are eating stores meant for {season}.
lines.note: {season} is deliberately unfilled: anchored liveness drops this line today

lines.text: There is not enough food in {settlement} and there is no longer a polite way to discuss it.
What {settlement}'s granary holds is being issued by rule rather than by price, and the rule is being tested.
{settlement}'s market is open and thin, and the thinness is not seasonal.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "occupied" (banner UNDER OCCUPATION) is on the record: crisis occupied is active (threat family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis occupied: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Another power's writ runs here. The offices are the same offices; the authority behind them is not.
Revenue leaves before it is spent: {settlement} is administered, and the administration is not its own.
The garrison is quartered inside the walls, and the town's business is conducted around it.
stop: soldiers / commander (the occupier's garrison: defence.garrison reads the town's own)
lines.note: "the garrison" is the occupier's, so the garrison atom is NOT declared

lines.text: {settlement} is held by somebody it did not choose, and the town's own hall now advises rather than decides.
Every licence, levy and permission in {settlement} passes a hand that is not the town's before it takes effect.
{settlement} functions and it functions under supervision, and the supervision is not disguised.
The occupiers are quartered inside the town, and the town's business is conducted around them.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "politically_fractured" (banner POLITICALLY FRACTURED) is on the record: crisis politically_fractured is active (succession family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis politically_fractured: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Nothing is decided. The factions each hold enough to block and none hold enough to rule, so the work of governing sits unattended.
Authority here is divided past the point of use. Repairs, judgments and appointments all wait on a consensus that does not arrive.
The town is governed in pieces, and the pieces do not agree; deferral has become the only policy anyone can pass.
{settlement} has no single answer to anything, because there is no longer anyone entitled to give one.
Two sets of instructions circulate in {settlement} and the clerks have quietly decided which to obey.
Asking {settlement} a simple question gets a careful one back, because the answer depends on who is asking for whom.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "indebted" (banner INDEBTED TO AN OUTSIDE POWER) is on the record: crisis indebted is active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis indebted: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: A share of everything {settlement} earns leaves for a creditor beyond the walls, and the share is not small.
The books balance only because nothing is being built. The debt is served first and the town second.
The obligation is outside and the payment is here; coin that would have gone to the works goes to the collector.
{settlement}'s obligations exceed what its year produces, and the shortfall is being met by promising against the next one.
What {settlement} owes is the first thing paid and the last thing discussed.
{settlement} looks like it is working hard for somebody, and the somebody is not in the town.
A share of everything {settlement} earns leaves for a creditor far from here, and the share is not small.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "recently_betrayed" (banner RECENTLY BETRAYED) is on the record: crisis recently_betrayed is active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis recently_betrayed: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Trust here is a shorter commodity than it was. Institutions run at partial strength because too few people will vouch for one another.
The betrayal is over and its consequences are not. Offices that once shared information now keep it.
{settlement} works, but it works suspiciously; the arrangements that depended on good faith have quietly lapsed.
{settlement} was let down by somebody it had reason to trust, and the town has grown careful in a way that reaches past the person responsible.
Agreements at {settlement} are being written longer than they used to be written, and the length is the town's answer.
{settlement} deals fairly with a stranger and slowly, and the slowness is deliberate.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "infiltrated" (banner INFILTRATED) is on the record: crisis infiltrated is active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis infiltrated: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Nothing here looks wrong. Decisions land slightly askew, and information reaches the wrong hands slightly too often.
The economy is untouched and the intelligence is not. Someone else's interest is being served inside the town's own rooms.
lines.note: "The economy is untouched" is false beside a famine, a siege or a debt

lines.text: The crisis is out of sight. The pattern is legible only to whoever is counting the coincidences.
Somebody in {settlement} answers elsewhere, and the town knows it without knowing who.
What {settlement}'s hall discusses and what {settlement}'s hall records have come apart.
Conversation in {settlement} stops when it should not and resumes carefully.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "plague_onset" (banner DISEASE OUTBREAK) is on the record: crisis plague_onset is active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis plague_onset: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: Illness is loose in the town. The market thins as people keep to their own doors, and travel is discouraged rather than forbidden.
lines.note: "travel is discouraged rather than forbidden" is false under a siege

lines.text: The sick outnumber the hands that can tend them, and the quarantine is observed unevenly, street by street.
{settlement} has stopped moving at its ordinary speed: supply arrives late, work goes undone, and the healers are the busiest people here.
lines.note: "the healers are the busiest people here"

lines.text: Sickness has come into {settlement}, and the town has begun organising itself around containment rather than around work.
{settlement} is keeping two lists now (the sick and the exposed), and neither list is shrinking.
Doors in {settlement} are marked, and the marking is recent enough that people still look at it.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "succession_void" (banner SUCCESSION VOID) is on the record: crisis succession_void is active (succession family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis succession_void: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: The seat is empty and no claim has settled. Major decisions are deferred; the institutions carry on under their own momentum.
There is no one to sign, so nothing is signed. Several offices have simply begun deciding for themselves.
Authority here has no undisputed heir, and the vacancy is being filled unofficially by whoever stands nearest the work.
The seat at {settlement} is empty and nobody has been able to say for certain who should fill it.
Instructions from {settlement}'s hall have stopped being signed, because there is nobody with the standing to sign them.
{settlement} answers questions about its own governance in the past tense.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "monster_pressure" (banner BEAST & RAIDER THREAT) is on the record: crisis monster_pressure is active (threat family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis monster_pressure: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: The roads outside are not safe. Trade arrives thinner and later, and what the town does not spend on defense it does not have.
Attacks on the outlying holdings have become regular enough to plan around, and the plans cost coin the town was spending elsewhere.
{settlement} keeps more watch than it can afford; the country beyond the walls has stopped being ordinary country.
lines.note: "keeps more watch than it can afford"

lines.text: Something in the country around {settlement} has made the outlying work dangerous, and the outlying work is not optional.
{settlement} has pulled its stock and its people inward, and the ground it has given up is on the rolls as abandoned.
The fields furthest from {settlement} are standing untended, and nothing about the season explains it.
{settlement} keeps more watch than it can afford; the country beyond the last houses has stopped being ordinary country.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "insurgency" (banner INSURGENCY) is on the record: crisis insurgency is active (unrest family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis insurgency: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: An armed movement operates inside the town's own population, and the town cannot tell it from the town.
Order here is enforced rather than kept. The authority that answers force with force is losing the argument that matters.
Parts of {settlement} are governed by the consent of people who hold no office; the rest is governed nervously.
Part of {settlement} is fighting the rest of it and neither part wears a badge.
The watch's patrols at {settlement} have been rewritten, and the routes now avoid places rather than cover them.
{settlement} is calm in a way that a stranger will not be able to trust for long.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "religious_conversion" (banner RELIGIOUS CRISIS) is on the record: crisis religious_conversion is active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis religious_conversion: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: The town's creed is contested from within. Congregations that once shared a calendar now keep separate ones.
stop: priest / faith presence beyond institution: temple

lines.text: A rival observance has taken root deep enough to divide households. The old rite still holds the buildings and no longer holds the street.
lines.note: "the old rite still holds the buildings"

lines.text: Faith here has become a question of allegiance rather than habit, and the question is being asked out loud.
What {settlement} keeps has changed, and the households have not all changed at the same rate.
{settlement}'s observances are being kept twice (in the new form publicly, in the old form otherwise), and the clerks record only one of them.
The altars in {settlement} are tended and the tending is new, which is visible in the stonework.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "slave_revolt" (banner SLAVE REVOLT) is on the record: crisis slave_revolt is active (unrest family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis slave_revolt: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: The bound labour of {settlement} has stopped being reliable, and the settlement was built on its reliability.
The work is not being done and the refusal is organized. What held the arrangement together was never consent.
The overseers keep order in the daylight hours; what happens after them is no longer theirs to decide.
The people {settlement} held have stopped being held, and the town has no arrangement for what follows.
{settlement}'s rolls are wrong in a way the clerks cannot correct: the names are there and the people are not where the names say.
{settlement} is a town with two populations and one of them has stopped pretending.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "wartime" (banner WARTIME) is on the record: crisis wartime is active (unrest family on).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis wartime: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: The town is on a war footing. Grain, iron and men are counted against a campaign rather than a season.
{settlement} lives at the rhythm of a war it is part of. Everything ordinary is scheduled around the levy.
The trades that matter here now are the ones that supply an army; the rest have been asked to wait.
{settlement} is at war, and the war has reached the town as absence: the men, the carts, and the ordinary expectation of next year.
{settlement}'s levies and requisitions have become the largest single line in the year, and they are not negotiable.
{settlement} is short of the kind of people a town this size should be full of.

pools.keyGuarantees: stress[].type === "mass_migration" (banner MASS MIGRATION) is on the record: crisis mass_migration is active; its direction is always influx (stressTypes.js, ruling 2 of 2026-10-30).
pools.ruling: Keyed on crisis mass_migration: opted in with poolCrisis; lines inherit it and declare only what they presume beyond the key.

lines.text: People are arriving faster than the town can house them. The camps outside the wall are becoming a second settlement.
lines.note: "are arriving faster" is false while nothing moves through the lines

lines.text: {settlement} has more mouths than arrangements. The administration is improvising, and the improvisation is visible.
The newcomers came from somewhere worse, and their arrival is reshaping what the town can afford.
People have come into {settlement} in numbers the town did not plan for, and the planning is happening after the fact.
{settlement}'s rolls have grown by {band} and its housing has not grown at all.
lines.note: {band} is RESERVED and unfilled: anchored liveness drops this line today

lines.text: There are more people in {settlement} than there is {settlement}, and the overflow is visible at the edges.
People are arriving faster than the town can house them. The camps at the edge of the town are becoming a second settlement.

pools.pool: ARITY: several banners standing at once
pools.keyGuarantees: crisisArityPoolKey: the banner reading holds MORE THAN ONE stress[] entry, so at least two crises are active.
pools.ruling: Keyed on two or more standing crises: opted in with poolCrisis ["crisis"]; no line denies a family.

lines.text: {settlement} is carrying more than one crisis at once, and they are not independent. Each makes the others harder to end.
No single emergency explains the state of the town; the troubles here compound, and the compounding is the real condition.
The town has run out of the slack it would need to solve any one of its problems, because it is solving several.

pools.keyGuarantees: crisisFramingPoolKey: the banner reading is a real, EMPTY stress[] list (the annex's "ARITY — no banner"); composed and never rendered on the Overview (R-DST-K).
pools.ruling: Every line asserts no crisis; stress[] empty does not rule out a pulse stressor folded in by crisisOf, so the pool opts in and every line is calm. Not empty for most births: the key already selects banner-less places.

lines.text: {settlement} carries no emergency. What troubles it are the ordinary troubles, and they are being handled at the ordinary pace.
Nothing here is urgent. The town's difficulties are chronic rather than acute, and it has the room to work on them.
There is no crisis on the books. Whatever strain the settlement carries, it carries at a weight it can hold.
